headline: Result Update

highlights: (LGEIL) Important Data LG Electronics India’s revenue grew by 19.5% YoY to ₹7,380crs in Q2FY27, driven by balanced volume and value growth across mass and premium segments.
EBITDA grew by 28% to ₹701crs, with margins expanded by 63 bps to 9.5%, while PAT grew by 25.7% to ₹489crs.
Gross margin remained flat at 29% YoY, impacted by commodity inflation and currency headwinds.
Home Appliances & Air Solutions revenue grew by 20.9% to ₹4,772crs, while Home Entertainment revenue grew by 17.2% to ₹2,608crs.
valuation: B2B Business Expansion • B2B currently contributes approximately 10–12% of the company's total revenue, with management targeting an increase to more than 15% over the next three years.

Exports are emerging as a key growth driver, with the company expanding its presence to 68 countries, while B2B contribution is targeted to increase from 10–12% currently to over 15% over the next three years.
At current levels, the stock trades at approximately 48x FY28E P/E and 29x FY28E EV/EBITDA, factoring in the company's strong growth prospects.
watch: Gross margin remained flat at 29% YoY, impacted by commodity inflation and currency headwinds.
Washing machines, refrigerators and room air conditioners were the key growth drivers, while dishwashers also delivered strong growth.
